comments.author: jerf
comments.story: We've spotted a planet surviving its dying star
comments.why: Black hole power using similar principles at higher efficiency
comments.text: Well, that very nearly is the method of power generation. It would presumably be paired with some sort of Dyson sphere around the white dwarf. (Remember that a "Dyson sphere" isn't necessarily a solid shell, but just some configuration of matter where no matter which direction the energy goes it is intercepted by something.) You may also enjoy: [VIDEO] which is a minutephysics on black hole power using much the same principles but attaining yet higher efficiencies.

comments.author: willis936
comments.story: Black hole paradoxes reveal a fundamental link between energy and order
comments.why: Quick info on Kugelblitzes and getting energy from black holes
comments.text: I don’t see why it’s unbelievable. High mass energy conversion is one of the least crazy things about black holes imo. For readers who want some quick info: [VIDEO] This PBS SpaceTime video doesn’t talk about the practical uses of Kugelblitzes, but it isn’t a big leap from understanding what they are to how to get energy out of them. Hawking radiation rate increases as schwarzschild radius decreases. If you could make a properly sized black hole you could convert a little bit of mass into a lot of energy. Maybe this could be harnessed to solve all electricity demand issues. Maybe it could be used to make a room sized bomb that blows up Earth. Vote now on your phones. [LINK]
